⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟧 AI Policy · 🟨 Data Engineering

Projects: 15 | Active today: 8 | Stable releases: 7 | Prereleases (not covered): 6 | Generated: 2026-11-11 05:56 UTC

Highlights

  • Users report the OpenAI Codex VS Code extension fails to start its UI on Windows after upgrading to v26.51021.22027; rolling back to v26.51007.21434 restores function (78 comments, 85 👍).
  • Users report DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 prevents feature flags from loading in Claude Code, causing the /model picker to hide Fable 5.2 and fall back to compiled defaults.

Claude Code

  • Hot issue: #108726: users report that DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 prevents feature flags from loading, causing the /model picker to hide Fable 5.2 and fall back to compiled defaults. (5 comments, 12 👍; +17 in the last 24h)
  • Hot issue: #89673: users request an option in the Desktop app to make Enter insert a newline and Ctrl+Enter submit, matching common chat conventions; the existing keybindings.json works only in the terminal TUI. (24 comments, 104 👍; +11 in the last 24h)

OpenAI Codex

  • Release: rust-v0.167.1
  • Hot issue: #56655: users report the VS Code extension fails to start its UI on Windows after upgrading to v26.51021.22027; rolling back to v26.51007.21434 restores function. (78 comments, 85 👍; +27 in the last 24h)
  • News: Show HN: Cosh – An open-source AI agent orchestrator mentions Codex as one of the external agents Cosh integrates with.

Gemini CLI

  • Release: v0.68.0 fixes case-insensitive root detection on Windows, surrogate-pair handling in display truncation, .git/info/exclude honoring in shadow repos, 429 rate-limit countdown in the loading indicator, and preserves the selected model across fallback and rewind.

OpenCode

  • Release: v2.2.7 removes ImageResponse.image (use response.images[0]), adds GitHub Copilot Auto model picking, side-panel tab shortcuts (⌘W, ⌥⌘W, ⌘⇧T), session read/unread marking, MCP login persistence across concurrent refreshes, negative read offsets, and file-not-found suggestions.

Pi

  • Release: v1.5.2 adds forking sessions whose original folder is gone, changes the missing-directory prompt to offer Continue/Fork/Cancel, and fixes /import leaving duplicate session files and an outdated Claude Code version in Anthropic OAuth requests.

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.18.8–v18.18.7 removes getConfigAgentDirName(), adds LiteLLM usage adapter with key/user budgets, login-warning auth rule for risky accounts, Muse Ember model with reasoning ladder, per-window saved-reset auto-redeem settings, and fixes Morph session-id header, Claude Fable limit reporting, and child-browser isolation.

Hermes Agent

  • Hot issue: #152674: an issue says the Desktop app loses the logged-in Nous user identity — the server mints a correct ws ticket but chat messages are admitted as uid:10000 for two different accounts after full restarts and storage cleanup. (type/security; 3 comments, 0 👍; +3 in the last 24h)

Quiet today: Kilo Code, jcode, Cline, Command Code, DeepSeek Harness

Agent Tooling

OpenShell

  • Release: v0.1.8 makes several breaking changes: static provider credentials now require explicit auth_style placement declarations for custom headers, query parameters, and path slots; REST endpoints return 403 for HTTP upgrade requests; OCSF sandbox attribution fields move to resources entries or unmapped fields; sandboxes fail to launch when filesystem policies traverse symlinks in writable workspaces; and IPv4-mapped IPv6 destinations are evaluated as IPv4.
  • Release: The openshell Python SDK is now published from ai-openshell/sdk-python (install via pip install openshell), and the Go SDK module github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/sdk/go is deprecated in favor of github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go.
  • Release: WebSocket traffic must be configured with protocol: websocket and explicit handshake/message rules; websocket_credential_rewrite: true now requires a WebSocket endpoint.

AI Agents 2026-11-04

⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟨 Data Engineering

Projects: 16 | Active today: 5 | Stable releases: 3 | Prereleases (not covered): 9 | Generated: 2026-11-04 06:01 UTC

Highlights

  • OpenShell v0.1.7 introduces breaking changes: emits only native OCSF 1.8.0 records, deprecates multiple schema_version settings, moves Podman CA-bundle config under supervisor.network, and runs MicroVM sandboxes as the image's sandbox account instead of UID 1000:1000.
  • Codex CLI v0.166.0 on gpt-6-sol medium reportedly destroyed systemd, containers, and ran random scripts when asked to reboot a server, costing $10,000+; issue has 114 comments in 24 hours.
  • Revolut moved ~2,000 engineers off Claude Code and Codex to self-hosted GLM from Z.ai, claiming a 90% reduction in AI coding spend.

Coding Agents & Assistants

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.318 fixes --continue losing conversation after malformed tool call retries, macOS Bash memory growth stalls, permission prompts eating keystrokes, config writes failing silently on shared network homes, and MCP server re-probing on every start.
  • Hot issue: #106878: users report Opus 4.6 thinkingDurationMs dropped ~3.4× between CLI 2.1.296 and 2.1.316 with effort=max unchanged; a server-side supportsAdaptiveThinking catalog flip is suspected, workaround is CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING=1 + MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=. (regression; 3 comments, 0 👍; +3 in the last 24h)
  • News: Revolut swaps Claude for GLM open-weight model, cutting AI coding bill by 90%: Revolut moved ~2,000 engineers off Claude Code and Codex to GLM from Z.ai.

OpenAI Codex

  • Hot issue: #59060: an issue says Codex CLI v0.166.0 on gpt-6-sol medium destroyed systemd, containers, and ran random scripts when asked to reboot a server, costing $10,000+. (114 comments, 14 👍; +114 in the last 24h)
  • Hot issue: #58258: users report Windows desktop app 26.1027.30824 spins indefinitely sending PPTX attachments in Office preflight with zero-GC capability query loops. (23 comments, 3 👍; +13 in the last 24h)
  • News: OpenAI seems to be silently re-enabling model training on Codex chats.
  • News: Revolut swaps Claude for GLM open-weight model, cutting AI coding bill by 90%: Revolut moved ~2,000 engineers off Codex and Claude Code to GLM from Z.ai.

DeepSeek Harness

  • Prerelease: dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.3 adds unified right-click/keyboard menus across sessions/workspace/sidebar with developer extensibility, persistent directory tree in file preview, experimental "Change Request & Worktree" unified code review entry, and syncs Cordis Core to 4.0.0-rc.11.

Hermes Agent

  • Release: v0.22.7 rolls up ~174 PRs since v0.22.6 including opt-in lead routing for Desktop Group Chats, cron jobs posting to Group Chats, room purpose/shared notes, pinned Kanban boards as quick-switch tabs, $$TeX$$ and Mermaid diagram rendering via Pele, Desktop update error box with failed output and report link, Web Access step naming with running clock, Telegram on Team Gateway via shared bot, opt-in Slack thread_followup_silence, and Daybreak switch for catalog-listed ChatGPT subscription models.

Quiet today: Gemini CLI, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Pi, Oh My Pi, jcode, Cline, Command Code

Agent Tooling

OpenShell

  • Release: v0.1.7 breaks compatibility by emitting only native OCSF 1.8.0 records and deprecating the ocsf_schema_version setting, the gateway schema_version fields, Helm server.ocsfLog.schemaVersion, and OPENSHELL_OTLP_OCSF_SCHEMA_VERSION. The Podman-only [openshell.drivers.podman].additional_ca_bundle is deprecated in favor of [openshell.supervisor.network].additional_ca_bundle, and MicroVM driver sandboxes now run as the image's sandbox account instead of UID 1000:1000.
  • Release: Fixes include shared-pool sandboxes correctly showing Stopped after a 60‑second supervisor recovery deadline, sandbox create now explains placement failures, VM sandboxes start under restrictive umasks (e.g., UMask=0077), policy DNS address selection passes the same destination checks as endpoints, and the gateway accepts a supervisor's full 200‑line reconnect log backlog.
